'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Jeffrey Johns DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Imperial Death Sentance
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
